---
title: smalldocs 0.3.0
subtitle: More options, and a warning for each option that is not read
date: 2026-10-16
author: Rahul Dave
categories: [release]
image: ../images/mark.svg
---

smalldocs now gives a warning for each key of the config that it does not read. It checks the keys
inside the navbar, the sidebar and a listing too. In front matter, it gives a warning only for an option of Quarto
that it does not read, so your own keys are fine. The options that run code, such as `jupyter` and
`freeze`, give a warning that says smalldocs runs no code. With `smalldocs render --strict`, a warning
makes the exit code 1. See
[Options that smalldocs does not read](../guide/config.qmd#options-that-smalldocs-does-not-read).

A site that uses none of the new options builds as before.

## Markdown

- Table captions, `: Caption {#tbl-a}`, and `tbl-cap-location`.
- Content for some builds only, with `.content-visible` and `.content-hidden`.
- The shortcodes `kbd` and `video`.
- Tabsets with the same `group` switch together.
- Code options: `code-line-numbers`, `code-overflow`, and `code-fold` with `code-summary`.
- Subscripts, `H~2~O`, and superscripts, `x^2^`.
- Lists numbered with letters or roman numerals.
- `fig-align`, `fig-alt`, and `layout-ncol`, `layout-nrow` and `layout` on a div.
- `callout-appearance` and `callout-icon` for each callout of a page.
- `anchor-sections` and `number-depth`.

See [Writing pages](../guide/markdown.qmd).

## Page and site

- The table of contents at the left, in the body or in two places, with `toc-location` and `toc-expand`.
- Fonts, colours and the width of the text from options, such as `mainfont` and `max-width`. See
  [Themes](../guide/themes.qmd#fonts-and-colours-from-options).
- More options for the navbar, the sidebar, the footer and the search box, and attributes such as
  `target` on each link.
- A logo for the light mode and one for the dark mode.
- `google-analytics`, `twitter-card`, `keywords`, `title-prefix`, `license` and `copyright`.
- `back-to-top-navigation`, `other-links`, `code-links`, `link-external-icon` and `smooth-scroll`.
- Drafts, with `draft-mode` and `drafts`.
- Comments on each page, with giscus, utterances or Hypothesis.

See [The configuration](../guide/config.qmd).

## Notebook cells

A code cell of a notebook can set `fig-cap`, `fig-alt`, `fig-align`, `tbl-cap`, `column`, `layout-ncol`
and the code options in its `#|` lines. See [Notebooks](../guide/notebooks.ipynb#figures-and-tables).
